{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|syrup}}
'''Syrup''' was a sticky<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> sugary [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> Syrup was naturally occurring, found in the soft centers of [[shellflower]]s,<ref name="EGTD" /> and distilled from [[Wroshyr louse/Legends|Wroshyr lice]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Varieties of syrup included [[Scale-5 syrup]],<ref name="CotJ" /> [[frill syrup]],<ref name="EdgeII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> [[Wroshyr lice syrup/Legends|Wroshyr lice syrup]],<ref name="CL" /> [[poptree syrup]],<ref name="MedStarI">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> [[Dantooine cane syrup]],<ref name="HuttCartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>, [[Steepara syrup]],<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref> [[Thesum-bark syrup]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and [[Zoochberry syrup]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=daily|Patissier for a Day|Dantooine}}</ref>
